Most sampled reviews that mention gameplay are positive, with 90 of 120 landing on the positive side against 20 negative and a handful of mixed or neutral takes. Players repeatedly describe the core loop in favorable terms: one calls it "Honestly one of the better roguelikes this year, the run variety keeps it fresh," another says "Solid deckbuilder," and a third praises "Good co-op" while noting "bad matchmaking." The same review adds that they "Would still recommend to friends."

Criticism recurs around friction and length. One player writes that "the inventory UI fights me constantly," another finds the game "a bit short for the price," and a third mentions "the pacing drags in act two." A separate review flags that "the servers shut down next month," advising players to "grab it on sale if at all." Performance and presentation also come up: one player notes it "Runs great on the Deck" with a complaint about "the tiny subtitle font," while another calls "The boss design is excellent" and the "Difficulty curve is brutal but fair." Opinion splits mainly on whether the rough edges outweigh the strong core, with no single dominant criticism beyond those recurring friction points.
